subject: Locking demo window + introduce security & procurement contacts
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: proposed next steps + demo windows

Hi Sarah — great conversation earlier, thanks for the context on your platform workload and the SSO/procurement timeline. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a 60–75 minute technical deep dive: 

- Aim: walk your infra/platform and security teams through a short demo (20 min), then 30 min on integration/SSO and 15–25 min Q&A + next steps.
- Suggested windows (PST): Tue 2026-02-03 10:00–11:15, Wed 2026-02-04 13:00–14:15, Thu 2026-02-05 08:30–09:45.
- Materials: attached a lightweight agenda and an invite file so you can drop the preferred slot into calendars.

Can you confirm which of the three windows works for Tom and any other stakeholders? If OK, I’ll loop in our procurement lead and security point so they can join the call and bring the SOC2/KMS notes.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0162
Redwood Inference

- We have a procurement checkpoint on 2026-02-10, so anything that surfaces procurement topics this week would be helpful.

Could you include the procurement contact so we can pre-seed any contract or SSO docs? I’ll confirm final attendee list by EOD Monday.

Excellent — Wed 2026-02-04 13:00–14:15 PST locked.

Looping in two folks on our side so we have the right coverage:
- Karthik Iyer (cc) — our security & compliance liaison (will come prepared with SOC 2, data residency and KMS notes).
- Priya Natarajan (cc) — procurement lead to help surface contracting timeline and any standard PO/process questions ahead of your 02-10 checkpoint.

Karthik/Priya: quick context — FinLytics (Sarah + Tom) run a high-throughput analytics pipeline and want to evaluate Redwood for serving embeddings and low-latency inference. Please bring any standard evidence or checklist items you expect customers to ask for; Sarah flagged SSO, audit logs, and KMS as likely questions.

Sarah/Tom: I attached the final agenda and will send a calendar invite with dial-in + Google Meet link. If you prefer a different meeting host (Zoom), let me know and we’ll swap the invite.

Next actions:
- Laura: send invite (with agenda + pre-read links) — by EOD today.
- Sarah: confirm if security lead will attend live or via recording — by EOD Monday.
- Priya/Karthik: if you have procurement or SOC2 artifacts we can pre-send, attach to the HubSpot deal or reply-all.

Thanks all — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Laura
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Quick note on evidence: Karthik — I’ll coordinate the SOC2 summary and the KMS integration checklist with you; once compiled we can pre-send to Sarah so their security review is faster.

Sarah/Tom — if you have any must-have contract terms (data residency, audit frequency, indemnity ceilings), signal them now so we can flag items in the one-pager. Otherwise I’ll surface the usual items and a proposed 30-day procurement prep timeline to match your 02-10 checkpoint.

Thanks — Priya
